first.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment for self-serve SMB accounts while retaining the full flow for complex workspaces. This directly addresses declining completion and activation, and prior evidence suggests durable activation gains. Verify the onboarding evidence and its churn boundary before committing. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior gains came with materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment for self-serve SMB accounts with simple workspaces, while explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts and preserving their full setup flow. Verified evidence shows strong completion, activation, time-to-value, and qualified-revenue gains in the target population. Monitor 30- and 60-day retention as guardrails because SMB retention declined slightly and complex workspaces previously suffered materially higher churn.
